hooks.command: cat | jq -r '.input.command // empty' | grep -q 'git commit' && echo '🔍 [UX-Hook] 检测到 git commit，建议运行 UX 评估：使用 Agent 工具启动 ux-evaluator agent' || true

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) BN=$(basename "$FILE"); ERRS_N=$(npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/openpipal-tsbuild-node.info 2>&1 | grep -E 'error TS' | grep "$BN(" | head -10); ERRS_W=$(npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/openpipal-tsbuild-web.info 2>&1 | grep -E 'error TS' | grep "$BN(" | head -10); ERRS="${ERRS_N}${ERRS_W}"; [ -n "$ERRS" ] && echo "⚠️ [tsc] 你刚改的 $BN 有类型错误:" && echo "$ERRS" ;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); DOT=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | tr " 	|;&<>()" "








" | grep -E '^[~./A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.env(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?$' | grep -v '\.env\.example$' | head -1); OP=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -oE '\.openpipal/(config\.json|acp-mcp\.token|oauth|mcp-servers\.json|mcp-app-permissions\.json|browser-control|tasks|audit\.log|plugins/[^/ ]+/mcp\.json)' | head -1); [ -n "$DOT$OP" ] && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"这条命令触到了凭据文件（项目 .env 或 ~/.openpipal 下的密钥/令牌/审批记录）。凭据不对 AI 开放——清单见 src/main/credential-paths.ts。确需查看请自己在终端跑。"}}'; exit 0
